title: Longformer: The Long-Document Transformer
hook: Most tokens only need to look at their neighbors, so swap full attention for a sliding window plus a few global tokens and the cost goes from quadratic to linear in sequence length.
key_points: Replaces full self-attention (quadratic in length) with an attention pattern that scales linearly.
Combines local sliding-window attention with a small amount of task-motivated global attention.
Outperformed RoBERTa on long-document tasks, with state-of-the-art results on WikiHop and TriviaQA at the time.
Introduces LED, a Longformer encoder-decoder for long-document sequence-to-sequence tasks.
content_html: Iz Beltagy, Matthew E. Peters, and Arman Cohan introduced Longformer in April 2020 to attack the central bottleneck of applying Transformers to long documents: standard self-attention costs scale quadratically with sequence length. Longformer's attention pattern scales linearly instead, making thousands-of-token documents practical.
extra_html:
How it works

Rather than letting every token attend to every other token, Longformer mostly uses local windowed (sliding-window) attention, where each token attends only to a fixed window of neighbors. On top of that it adds a small amount of global attention on a handful of task-motivated tokens, so the model can still route information across the whole document where it matters. The authors also describe LED, a Longformer-Encoder-Decoder variant for long-document sequence-to-sequence tasks.

Why it matters

The linear-scaling attention let Longformer handle inputs far longer than a vanilla Transformer could fit. Beltagy and colleagues report that it outperformed RoBERTa on long-document tasks and set state-of-the-art results on WikiHop and TriviaQA at the time, showing that you can keep most of the modeling power of attention while dropping its quadratic cost.

related.title: Attention Is All You Need
related.hook: Drop recurrence and convolution, keep only attention — and you get a model that trains in parallel and powers nearly every LLM since.

related.title: FlashAttention: Fast, Memory-Efficient Exact Attention
related.hook: Attention got faster not by approximating it, but by being smarter about GPU memory — never writing the giant attention matrix out to slow memory.

flashcards.prompt: Why does Longformer add global attention on a handful of tokens?

choices.text: So the model can still route information across the whole document where it matters
To make attention quadratic again for accuracy
To replace the sliding window entirely

flashcards.explanation_html: A small amount of global attention lets information flow across the full document while local windowing keeps cost linear.
